style: Use case: stylized-concept. One square collectible achievement icon for the Forma gym kiosk. A single centered upright hexagonal enamel medal with crisp bevelled cool silver rim, recessed deep midnight-blue enamel field, and a playful miniature sculpted enamel subject with a splash of warm amber or seafoam. A coherent premium game pin, nearly front-on orthographic, main motif occupying 70% of the badge, strongly legible at 80 pixels, subtle upper-left light, simple silhouettes, no people, no lettering, numbers, watermark, stars indicating level or decorative writing. Entire medal visible with 6% margin on a perfectly uniform near-black navy #09131c square background.

subjects.start.first_workout:t1: FIRST REAL WORKOUT / ‘the sofa has a day off’ — an unmistakable small cozy golden-yellow sofa and two bright teal lace-up training shoes already stepping away from it, one in front of the other. This friendly little joke about starting exercise is the whole story. No computer disks or technology.
subjects.start.first_workout:t2: A pair of teal training shoes unpacking themselves from a little open mustard-yellow vintage suitcase. A loose lace curls cheerfully, bold readable shape. The second milestone is settling into the gym.
subjects.start.first_workout:t3: A permanent blue gym membership pass in the unmistakable simple shape of a rounded card with punched lanyard hole. Its raised gold emblem is a dumbbell and a checkmark, with short teal lanyard. No text at all.
subjects.signature.reunited_pairs:t1: Two very distinct little squat kettlebells leaning toward each other in conversation, one amber and one turquoise. Over them two overlapping ivory graphic speech bubbles, one tiny dot in each. Returning workout partners form a group chat.
subjects.return.rediscovered:t1: A retro teal kettlebell lifted slightly from an open golden keepsake box, a little twinkle where dust was wiped off and one tiny calendar tab behind. Rediscovering a familiar exercise after a long rest. Cheerful reunion.
subjects.calendar.month_bridge:t1: Two visibly separate flipped ring-bound calendar leaves, linked by a tiny arched amber footbridge with a teal training shoe crossing. A recurring exercise links two calendar months. Bold simple central composition.
subjects.duet.machine_stretch:t1: A compact gold iron barbell resting across the unfurling end of a turquoise rolled exercise mat. The loose mat curves gracefully below the straight iron bar. Strength machine and stretching in one workout.
subjects.practice.reps:t1: A beautiful working mechanical tally counter fused with a miniature barbell, three glossy amber counting wheels (plain circles or dots only, no numerals) in a teal housing with one chunky click button.
subjects.rhythm.active_days:t1: A standing warm ivory tear-off calendar with two blue binding rings, exactly five plump turquoise or amber enamel dots stamped on its blank grid and a small marker tip. Clearly a collection of training dates.
subjects.signature.remix: A DJ turntable where the spinning vinyl record is an unmistakable small gym weight plate, one golden tonearm, a teal swap arrow. Joke about remixing a familiar workout with one exercise substituted.
subjects.discovery.club_host: Three small gym objects invited to a club, a central smiling teal kettlebell holding open a little velvet rope to let in two different smaller weights. Strong flat silhouettes and warm social humor.
subjects.calendar.format_relay: Two abstract sports glove hands handing off a tightly rolled teal yoga mat like a relay baton, amber speed marks and a little calendar tab. Distinct workout formats passing the baton across a week.
subjects.duet.bodyweight_machine: One teal athletic sneaker with its laces clasping a very clear short gold barbell, like two training partners shaking hands, bold and simple.
subjects.duet.machine_timed: A gold barbell standing diagonally in front of one big teal stopwatch, suggesting timed exercise and machine training in one workout.
subjects.duet.bodyweight_stretch: A single laced turquoise trainer resting on an unfurling saffron exercise mat with elegantly curled edges. Compact isolated objects and no other equipment.
subjects.duet.bodyweight_timed: A teal sneaker propelled gently forward by a round hand-held gold stopwatch with two top buttons. Clear silhouettes of bodyweight practice and timed exercise.
subjects.duet.stretch_timed: A golden stopwatch softening gently over the rounded edge of a teal yoga mat, like time itself is stretching. Polished, simple and cheerful.

subjects.calendar.season_2: A small golden summer sunhat with a broad brim resting on a teal dumbbell, a little summer sun flare, bold clear and funny in silhouette.
subjects.calendar.season_3: A bright amber maple leaf caught on a turquoise training-shoe lace, a second copper leaf floating nearby. A distinct autumn sports collectable.
